beats.say: Attackers pick leaders on purpose. One signature or one call from you can move large sums and big decisions.
This is called whaling. The email is tailored to your role and speeches, so it looks very convincing.

body.text: We watched your TV interview last week and would like you as our keynote speaker.
To see the programme, sign in with your work account:
The invitation is confidential, please do not share it with your assistant.

beats.say: Artificial intelligence can copy your voice from a short recording. A call from you to your deputy may be fake.
Your assistant is a target too. Agree that money or data requests are checked on a second channel, even from you.

scenes.prompt: Find the signs of a whaling email.

body.text: We watched your TV interview last week and would like you as our keynote speaker.
To see the programme, sign in with your work account:
The invitation is confidential, please do not share it with your assistant.

spots.label: Unknown domain
spots.explain: Anyone can register an official-sounding name. Look the organisation up yourself and check.

spots.label: Trust built on public info
spots.explain: Your interview is public. Mentioning it does not prove they know you.

spots.label: Work account sign-in
spots.explain: You do not need a work password to read an invitation. This is meant to steal a leader's account.

spots.label: Cut out the assistant
spots.explain: Your assistant is your line of checks. Be wary of any email that wants them left out.

nodes.text: Approve the payment to our partner tonight, I will send the papers later.
nodes.speaker: The minister's voice (20:00)
nodes.spoken: Approve the payment to our partner tonight, <breath> I will send the papers later.

choices.label: I hang up and call the minister's known number myself
choices.feedback: Right. A voice can be faked, a known number is a reliable check.

choices.label: The voice is familiar, I approve the payment
choices.feedback: A familiar voice is no longer proof. The money went to a fraudster's account.

nodes.text: The minister is on a plane and has called no one.
nodes.speaker: The minister's assistant
nodes.spoken: The minister is on a plane <breath> and has called no one.

choices.label: I report it to security at once and warn finance
choices.feedback: Correct. The attacker may now try another colleague.

choices.label: Nothing, I did not pay anyway
choices.feedback: You were safe, but your deputy may be next. Reporting protects everyone.

nodes.text: In the morning your team asks: how do we talk about this?

choices.label: I speak openly and confirm the check rule for everyone
choices.feedback: Excellent. When the leader talks openly, the team takes the rule seriously.

choices.label: We keep it quiet, it hurts our reputation
choices.feedback: Silence leaves others unprotected. Openness builds trust.

scenes.prompt: Is this request to your assistant safe?

body.text: I am in a meeting, cannot call. Buy 10 gift cards today and send photos of the codes here.

cards.explain: Gift card codes are like cash and cannot be recovered. Avoiding a call is another sign.

body.text: The agenda is attached. The meeting is on the third floor.

cards.explain: Correct domain, expected topic, no request for money or data.

messages.text: It is your director, new number. Send me my calendar and where tomorrow's meetings are.

cards.explain: A leader's calendar reveals where they will be. Check a new number through a known channel.

body.text: The payment request was created in the internal system and awaits a second signature, as the rules require.

cards.explain: The request runs through the official system and needs a second signature. That is the right process.

scenes.title: An evening payment
scenes.intro: It is 19:52. An urgent payment is waiting for your approval in the finance system.

body.text: Payee: Qafqaz Terefdash LLC, new bank account
Note: the minister asked by phone, pay tonight, documents later.

steps.say: Look at the payee and the note.

actions.label: Hold and verify
actions.feedback: Correct. An urgent payment to a new account is always checked on a channel you know.

actions.label: Approve
actions.feedback: A new account, urgency and documents later are signs of fraud. The money went to a fake account.

title.text: How do you verify the instruction?

body.text: The note gives a contact number: +994 50 000 71 30

actions.label: Call the minister's assistant on the number I know
actions.feedback: Correct. A number you already know exposes a fake instruction at once.

actions.label: Call the number in the note
actions.feedback: The number in the note belongs to the attacker, who will "confirm" the order.

body.text: The assistant says the minister gave no such order.

actions.label: Report to the security team
actions.feedback: Excellent. The attacker will try another signatory next, your report warns everyone.

actions.label: Cancel the payment and move on
actions.feedback: Stopping it is good, but the attacker will try someone else. Report it.

question.prompt: What should a leader do in the first hour of an incident?

options.label: Bring in the security team at once
options.feedback: Correct. The sooner specialists start, the less damage.

options.label: Pick a way to talk outside work email
options.feedback: Correct. The attacker may be reading email, so use phones or a separate channel.

options.label: Approve isolating systems as soon as specialists advise it
options.feedback: Correct. A fast decision from the top stops the spread.

options.label: Hide the incident to protect reputation
options.feedback: Hiding it causes bigger harm later and can break reporting obligations.

options.label: Answer the ransom demand quickly
options.feedback: Any contact with attackers is decided together with specialists and lawyers.

scenes.explain: In the first hour a leader speeds up decisions and backs the team.

scenes.prompt: Check an urgent payment request in the right order.

items.label: Call back on a number you know

scenes.explain: Urgency is the attacker's main weapon. A few minutes of checking prevent a big loss.

points: However senior the request, check it on a second channel.
Agree the check rule with your assistant in advance.
In an incident, decide calmly, openly and fast.
